questions.skill: Use structure to factor perfect squares and expressions in quadratic form
questions.standard_level: Algebra I. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Algebra I, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: Factor completely. (Think of x² as one quantity.) x⁴ - 5x² + 4
questions.prompt_markup:
Factor completely. (Think of x² as one quantity.)
x⁴ - 5x² + 4
questions.grading_note: Form required: factored completely. With u = x²: u² - 5u + 4 = (u - 1)(u - 4) = (x² - 1)(x² - 4), and each factors again.

questions.prompt_markup:
Factor, and simplify each factor. (Think of x + 1 as one quantity.)
(x + 1)² - 9
questions.grading_note: Form required: factored and simplified. It is a difference of squares: ((x + 1) - 3)((x + 1) + 3).

questions.prompt: Find all real zeros of f(x) = x⁴ - 5x² + 4.

questions.grading_note: Any order. All four are required. f(x) = (x² - 1)(x² - 4).
